title_ar: وفد من أعضاء منتدى كوالالمبور للفكر و الحضارة يلتقون برئيس الوزراء الماليزي الدكتور مهاتير محمد رئيس المنتدى
title_en: A Delegation of Members of the Kuala Lumpur Forum for Thought and Civilisation Meets the Malaysian Prime Minister Dr Mahathir Mohamad, Chairman of the Forum
body_ar:
التقى رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء و رئيس جامعة عبد الله بن ياسين بموريتانيا الشيخ محمد الحسن بن الددو رفقه أعضاء من منتدى كوالالمبور للفكر و الحضارة رئيس الوزراء الماليزي : الدكتور مهاتير محمد

وقد ناقش المجتمعون قضايا مختلفة تهم الأمة الإسلامية من أبزرها القضايا المتعلقة بالديمقراطية و الحريات العامة و بعض من القضايا التي تدخل ضمن أهداف منتدى كوالالمبور للفكر و الحضارة الذي يرأسه رئيس الوزراء الماليزي الدكتور: مهاتير محمد ويشغل فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو فيه منصب النائب الأول للرئيس

وجرى اللقاء في مدينة اسطمبول التركية حيث يقيم فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن بن الددو

وكما ناقش المجتمعون مع الرئيس الماليزي سبل النهوض وتطوير المنتدى في قابل الأيام.

و"منتدى كوالالمبور"، مؤسسة فكرية عالمية تأسس عام 2014 في ماليزيا من طرف عدد كبير من العلماء و الشخصيات الفكرية والسياسية في العالم العربي و الاسلامي

ويهتم المنتدى بقضية الديمقراطية والحريات العامة إضافة إلى الوساطة والمصالحة وحل أزمات العالم الإسلامي
body_en:
The president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars and rector of Abdullah ibn Yasin University in Mauritania, Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan ibn al-Dedew, accompanied by members of the Kuala Lumpur Forum for Thought and Civilisation, met the Malaysian prime minister, Dr Mahathir Mohamad.

Those meeting discussed various matters of concern to the Muslim Ummah, the most prominent of them matters relating to democracy and public freedoms, and some of the matters falling within the aims of the Kuala Lumpur Forum for Thought and Civilisation, which is chaired by the Malaysian prime minister Dr Mahathir Mohamad and in which His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew holds the position of first deputy chairman.

The meeting took place in the Turkish city of Istanbul, where His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan ibn al-Dedew resides.

Those meeting also discussed with the Malaysian [prime minister] ways of advancing and developing the Forum in the days ahead.

The Kuala Lumpur Forum is an international intellectual institution founded in 2014 in Malaysia by a large number of scholars and intellectual and political figures in the Arab and Islamic world.

The Forum concerns itself with the question of democracy and public freedoms, as well as mediation, reconciliation and the resolution of the crises of the Muslim world.

flags.arabic: وكما ناقش المجتمعون مع الرئيس الماليزي
flags.context: the fourth paragraph, which calls Dr Mahathir الرئيس الماليزي after calling him رئيس الوزراء twice
options: read as an ellipsis for رئيس الوزراء الماليزي and render 'the Malaysian prime minister', marking the supplied words, as done here
render literally as 'the Malaysian president', preserving the source's error
render as 'the chairman', reading رئيس as referring to his chairmanship of the Forum
flags.note: SOURCE DEFECT, recorded not fixed. Malaysia has no president; Dr Mahathir Mohamad was prime minister, as the same report states twice. The third reading is also live, since the sentence is about the Forum and he chairs it. The English marks the supplied words in square brackets rather than silently correcting, per style guide section 11. body_ar preserves the Arabic as served.

flags.context: الشيخ محمد الحسن بن الددو رفقه أعضاء من منتدى كوالالمبور
options: read as رفقةَ, 'accompanied by', as done here
mark the word as corrupt and leave it unrendered
flags.note: SOURCE DEFECT. رفقه (with a final hāʾ) stands where رفقة, 'in the company of', is required. The reading is not in doubt from the syntax. Preserved in body_ar.

translator_notes: Further source defects preserved in body_ar and recorded here, not fixed (style guide section 11): أبزرها for أبرزها ('the most prominent of them'); اسطمبول for إسطنبول; الاسلامي without hamzah for الإسلامي; and تأسس (masculine) agreeing with مؤسسة (feminine).
مركز تكوين العلماء is rendered 'the Centre for the Formation of Scholars', the institution's own English name; تكوين here is formation or training, not 'composition'.
النائب الأول للرئيس is 'first deputy chairman' of the Forum, matching رئيس المنتدى, 'chairman of the Forum', in the title.
A news report. It states no ruling and engages no legal category.

The CMS timestamp is a bulk-upload/publication stamp, not the date on which the Sheikh gave the answer. Records across this slice carry timestamps clustered minutes apart on the same day (e.g. 1038/1039/1040 at 08:13/08:14/08:14 on 8 August 2019; 1077/1078/1079 at 09:50/09:52/09:53 on 22 July 2020), which is the signature of a batch upload. date_is_cms_upload is therefore set true throughout.
